title: The Principal Gradient
bluf: Cortex is not just a set of parcels; it is organized along a continuous sensorimotor-to-transmodal axis.
changes: You will read network maps as positions on a gradient, not just as named islands.

citations.title: Situating the default-mode network along a principal gradient

title: Brodmann to HCP-MMP1: 100 Years of Cortical Mapping
bluf: Brodmann remains essential pedagogy, while HCP-MMP1 gives a modern multimodal surface atlas.
changes: You will stop treating BA numbers as ground truth and start using them as historical crosswalks.

citations.title: A multi-modal parcellation of human cerebral cortex

title: BICCN: When Cells Became the Ground Truth
bluf: Cell identity now constrains anatomy from below rather than decorating it from above.
changes: You will ask what cell classes occupy a parcel before assigning a single function to it.

citations.title: Transcriptomic diversity of cell types across the adult human brain

title: How Tau Spreads in Alzheimer's: The Braak Hypothesis
bluf: Tau staging is a spatial story: transentorhinal cortex first, primary cortex late.
changes: You will distinguish amyloid burden from tau topography when interpreting AD maps.

citations.title: Biomarker modeling of Alzheimer disease stages

title: The Cerebellum Is Not Just for Movement
bluf: Cerebellar damage can produce cognitive and affective deficits, not only ataxia.
changes: You will read Crus I/II and dentate projections as cognitive circuitry.

citations.title: The cerebellar cognitive affective/Schmahmann syndrome scale

title: Dual-Stream Language: A 50-Year Synthesis
bluf: Dorsal stream maps sound to articulation; ventral stream maps sound to meaning.
changes: You will separate conduction aphasia from semantic comprehension failures by pathway.

citations.title: The cortical organization of speech processing

title: The Default Mode Network
bluf: The DMN began as a task-negative observation and became a core organizing principle.
changes: You will treat mind-wandering, memory, and ToM as overlapping transmodal computations.

citations.title: The organization of the human cerebral cortex estimated by intrinsic functional connectivity

title: Place Cells, Grid Cells, and the Cognitive Map
bluf: Hippocampal place cells and entorhinal grid cells form complementary spatial codes.
changes: You will see the medial temporal lobe as a representational map engine.

citations.title: Microstructure of a spatial map in the entorhinal cortex

title: Why Is the Locus Coeruleus First to Fall in Alzheimer's?
bluf: LC vulnerability links neuromodulatory reach, tau susceptibility, and early arousal/cognition symptoms.
changes: You will inspect the brainstem before calling AD a purely cortical disease.

citations.title: Human locus coeruleus stereology and vulnerability

title: Pearl + the Brain: Identifiability in Neural Circuits
bluf: A directed graph is not a causal model until interventions and assumptions are explicit.
changes: You will mark many circuit claims plausible until the causal estimand is identified.

citations.title: Causal inference in statistics: An overview

title: The 5 Cardinal Interneuron Classes
bluf: PV, SST, VIP, LAMP5, and SNCG give a usable Rosetta Stone for cortical inhibition.
changes: You will read inhibition by target compartment and transcriptomic class.

citations.title: Shared and distinct transcriptomic cell types across neocortical areas

title: Striosomes and Matrix
bluf: The striatum hides compartmental structure that changes how direct and indirect pathways are read.
changes: You will stop flattening all medium spiny neurons into one diagram.

citations.title: Striosomal indirect pathway through central-zone GPe
